description: This Java class defines mapping strategies for message command responses within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It maps different types of message responses to their corresponding JsonifiableMapper implementations, facilitating the conversion of message command responses to JSON format.

classes.name: MessageCommandResponseMappingStrategies
classes.description: Final class that implements singleton pattern. It extends AbstractMessageMappingStrategies to provide specific mapping strategies for various MessageCommandResponse types based on signal type.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton instance of the class.

methods.name: initMappingStrategies
methods.description: Initializes and returns a map associating signal type strings with JsonifiableMapper lambdas.

methods.name: featureIdForMessageFrom
methods.description: Extracts the feature ID from the Adaptable's payload path, throws JsonParseException if not present.
